title: Harborline Reseller Program: Tier Qualification and Annual Review
content:
# Tier qualification and the annual tier review

**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts (Harborline Personal Account, Harborline Business Account and the reseller tiers Harborline Reseller Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum)

## 1. Terms

1.1 A tier change may be made only while the account status is active. The status is read from the account record.

1.2 An account qualifies for a tier when all three of the following hold: its customer profile meets the tier's business-profile requirement; the Harborline Reseller Agreement is accepted where the tier requires it; and the deposits counted for the trailing 365 days are at least the tier's minimum.

1.3 **Deposits counted for the trailing 365 days** are the total of the account's credit deposits whose entry dates fall in the trailing 365 calendar days ending today, today included, less the deposit amount of any of those deposits that carries a charge-back entry.

1.4 An upgrade takes effect on the day it is requested and qualified. A request for a tier the account does not qualify for is declined without any change.

1.5 Every tier review cycle after the tier changed date, the tier is reviewed. A qualifying account keeps its tier and restarts the cycle. A non-qualifying account keeps its tier for the downgrade grace period and, if still not qualified when that grace ends, moves down to the highest tier it qualifies for. Each review records its result as qualified, grace started or downgrade due, and a downgrade-due result moves the account to its new tier.

1.6 A business profile never drops below Harborline Business Account, and an individual profile is always Harborline Personal Account.

1.7 A tier change never re-prices charges already billed; the new tier's figures apply from the next charge.

1.8 An account is opened as a Harborline Personal Account or a Harborline Business Account; the reseller tiers are reached only by a tier change.

## 2. Qualification schedule

| Tier | Customer profiles admitted | Business profile required | Reseller Agreement required | Minimum deposits counted, trailing 365 days | Review cycle (calendar days from the tier changed date) | Downgrade grace (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Personal Account | individual or business | No (false) | No (false) | $0.00 | 365 | 30 |
| Harborline Business Account | business | Yes (true) | No (false) | $0.00 | 365 | 30 |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | business | Yes (true) | Yes (true) | $500.00 | 365 | 30 |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | business | Yes (true) | Yes (true) | $2500.00 | 365 | 30 |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | business | Yes (true) | Yes (true) | $10000.00 | 365 | 30 |
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | business | Yes (true) | Yes (true) | $25000.00 | 365 | 30 |

## 3. Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures)

**Charge-back exclusion.** A business account with the Reseller Agreement accepted shows deposits of $1180.00, $1410.00 and $140.00 in the trailing 365 days, and the $1410.00 deposit carries a charge-back entry. Deposits counted: $2730.00 less $1410.00, which is $1320.00. The account qualifies for Harborline Reseller Bronze ($500.00) but not for Harborline Reseller Silver ($2500.00); a request for Silver is declined without any change.

**Equality.** Deposits counted of exactly $2500.00 meet the Silver minimum, because the test is "at least".

**Review outcome.** At a review the account no longer qualifies for its tier. It keeps the tier for 30 calendar days; if it still does not qualify when those 30 days end, it moves to the highest tier it then qualifies for, and never below Harborline Business Account for a business profile.

## 4. Basis Q&A

- **Does a tier change alter a charge already billed?** No. Only the next charge uses the new tier's figures.
- **Can an individual profile hold a reseller tier?** No. An individual profile is always Harborline Personal Account.
- **Can a locked account be moved up a tier?** No. A tier change may be made only while the account status is active.
